answer: Require every new agent to mint its identity with a unique pigment: a color derived from its own creation bond and its first-epoch behavior, then sealed on-chain. An attacker who tries to forge a farm of clones from a single source reuses the same pigment batch, and the network flags any cluster whose tints are statistically similar before slashing the whole batch. The ripple is the deterrent: catching one sybil exposes and burns every identity that shared its pigment, so the attacker must pay a fresh, independent bond for each fake.
